objective: Eliminate dead code and unused exports identified by Knip in core codebase.

findings.evidence: Knip reported unused exports in core/context.ts (getConfig, getMiaDir, getSlug), core/config/schema.ts (DaemonConfig, PathsConfig, SkillsConfig, FeaturesConfig), and core/verification/run-checks.ts (VerificationResult).
findings.impact: Unused exported symbols caused build/lint noise and maintenance drift.
findings.action: Removed unused export statements in core/context.ts and core/config/schema.ts, and unexported internal VerificationResult interface in core/verification/run-checks.ts.

changes: Removed export { getConfig, getMiaDir, getSlug } from core/context.ts.
Removed unused type exports DaemonConfig, PathsConfig, SkillsConfig, FeaturesConfig from core/config/schema.ts.
